key.name: five-percent-steps
key.description: When enabled, volume always moves in 5% increments. Keyboard volume keys, headset volume wheels, scrolling, and the Quick Settings slider all land on 0, 5, 10, and so on, instead of mixed 5/6% or 10% jumps.

key.name: show-volume-number
key.summary: Show volume number in Quick Settings
key.description: When enabled, a small number box appears next to the sound slider in Quick Settings. The current volume is shown there, and you can type a new value to set it.
